text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I have decided to enter
the American Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Afterward, a race in the UK was also scheduled—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
These will likely prove to be
the greatest challenges of my racing career.
(Oooohhhhh...!)
Cesario's future outlook caused quite a stir in the public—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You really came up with something quite outrageous, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Now it's gonna feel even lonelier~...!
But still, I'm totally rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It's an unfamiliar land, so please take good care of yourself. Do your best, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Teacher!
Do your best, Teacher~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
It's all anyone in the shopping district can talk about!
Do your best in the American Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Eat well and sleep well!
It seemed to greatly boost Cesario's own motivation as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to incorporate a new routine into our training for the race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Based on the motion analysis data, I want to create a regimen that further builds the specific muscle strength I need right now—"

How should I improve my current physical capabilities
to adapt to the environment over there?

"Strengthening the body through an appropriate training workload.
Along with leg care and health management—"
Preparations for traveling to the US proceeded steadily.

The days flew by like arrows—
and one day, a few days before departure.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We have pretty much everything we need, right?
All that's left is the adapter plug, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A home improvement store or an electronics shop, maybe...?
Let's take a look around. Umm...
—Faintly, but unmistakably.
Looking at Cesario's posture as she stood, I felt an indescribable sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter, Trainer?
Even so, it was such a minute difference that it couldn't be explained in detail right away—
choice_data_list: ...Shall we head back and check on your legs?
...Shall we head back and check on your legs?

text_block_list.text:
I did a basic palpation and checked what I could,
but... I couldn't find anything out of the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"From what I can see, nothing seems amiss...
You're not in any pain, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, not just pain, but I don't really feel any discomfort at all...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...If you don't mind me saying, weren't you just being a bit sensitive before the overseas expedition?

Still, something's bothering me.
Something just feels off.

I felt strongly, for some reason,
that I must not overlook this sense of unease.
choice_data_list: Let's go get a thorough examination now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
If that is what you say, let us go.

Afterward,
we insisted on getting a detailed medical checkup—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but the results won't be ready until tomorrow.
Around noon, perhaps... Please come by to pick them up then.

Around noon the next day. Since Cesario had class,
I went to pick up the test results by myself—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: There was a slight inflammation.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Right around here, yes. It's a recurrence of the inflammation.
Though it's so faint, I'm honestly impressed you managed to notice it."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, there would be no need for concern...
but if it's a recurrence, that changes things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: If you push yourself too hard right now, it's not impossible that this could become a chronic issue.
choice_data_list: ...Still, from here on out, that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: The American Oaks awaits.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I am aware.
I know what a massive challenge this is for the two of you as well.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Since we caught it this far in advance,
and given the severity, it's more than likely
that running in the race won't be an issue."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
to an Umamusume, racing is life itself—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: As for whether to enter the race, I'll leave that decision to the two of you.
Cesario has staked everything on this challenge.

I can never forget the radiant, bursting smile
that usually composed girl showed.

As long as we're careful, there shouldn't be any problem.
I definitely want to let her take on the challenge.
What if something happens?
I tell myself I'm overthinking it, yet only unpleasant thoughts come to mind.
choice_data_list: (...In any case, let's test it out.)

text_block_list.text:
Any injury can worsen if pushed too hard from minor symptoms.
The word "recurrence" is likely fueling anxiety unconsciously.
I pull out all our accumulated data, the data gathered for taking on overseas challenges, and every relevant reference book.

Are there any similar cases in the past—
Is there a form that reduces the burden—
What about care better suited to her legs—

The progression of a recurring injury turning chronic—
The load placed on legs by the softness of the local turf—
The Umamusume who were forced to retire due to race injuries in the past—
The accumulated data proved helpful for my research.
Yet, no answer came.
choice_data_list: (There's no telling if it'll get worse)

text_block_list.text:
She traveled to the US and ran in the race.
She seized a brilliant victory and grasped the crown.
Her racing career continued smoothly thereafter.

"There is a very real possibility of that.
And I truly wish to see it with my own eyes."
Even so—
choice_data_list: (As a Trainer, I ought to stop this.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...What did you just say?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Next is that.
choice_data_list: ...Let's give up on the American Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood.
It was eerily simple. I had expected some questioning or debate.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If she were to race, claim victory, and only then suffer an injury, that would be one thing, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If by some chance she loses,
and is forced into retirement because of it...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will not be able to reach the place I longed for.
In that case, withdrawing is the sound decision.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――?
Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There is still much to achieve in domestic races.
First off, claiming victory in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Running flat out toward the immediate goal—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...We can figure out our future direction in due time.
Would that be all right with you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let's head to the gym first, then.
I believe today's training will focus primarily on the upper body.

Without waiting for my response,
Cesario headed off to train.
With that posture, spine standing straight and tall.
